== Biography ==
Margaret was born in 1723. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1927|John Glasgow]] and [[Gemill-4|Mary Gemill]]. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1927]] is assessed at 78% (probable). Margaret’s 1723 transcript names John and Mary Gemmill, securely defining the Kilwinning parent pair. Same name and feasible age favour the existing 1671 John account but do not establish its cross-parish adult continuity.

Complete existing child-to-father-profile proposition, including the father’s childhood-to-adult identification; literal named parental role is stronger and assessed separately in the basis.

Next useful test: Inspect p178 and seek the earlier Margaret’s burial only to clarify sibling chronology.
